author: sdnightfly
text_post: See if you can get her email just to keep in touch or if she comes back in town.  Problem: your friend disrupted the momentum. 10 minutes after he got there, she was ready to end the night with you.  My phone's off if it's just me and her in a place. You're only going to see her this one time. You can talk to them later. What would they do if they were in your shoes?   An hour at the bar, I probably would've said we should go hang out at my place for a little bit and maybe come back later. If she brings up the friend thing, just time it out and tell her you have it handled, and she'll be home. You want to get her to your place first. But just ask her where her friend's at, make it sound like it's not that far from your place, and odds are she'll call the friend in the taxi letting her know she'll be out a little later, or when she gets to your place.   She might resist it, she might not, but if she's completely into you, odds are she doesn't want the night to end yet. And the entire way, you keep talking, making out, making her feel really good until you get to your place, turn the music on, pour her a drink, and whatever happens, happens. It should be pressure-free, fun, more exciting for her than for you. For you it should be "I just want you to have a good time even if we're just going to kick back and hang out".  Me: Hey HB, you enjoying XXXXX? When are you back in YYYYY? HB: Tomorrow, then leaving fri. May not have the chance to hang again, but thanks for the fun last time Me: Give me a call later.
